subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic mode use the most-used supported binding quota lane for both menu-bar display and highest-usage ranking, even when another model family or weekly lane remains usable?
rationale: Both behaviors are defensible, but changing the automatic default alters what existing users see and the repository history does not establish whether usable fallback or binding exhaustion is the permanent contract.

options.title: Adopt one binding lane
options.body: Use the shared maximum-usage supported quota lane for both consumers so the displayed value matches the lane that caused Antigravity to rank highest.

options.title: Preserve usable fallback
options.body: Keep current automatic behavior when any usable lane remains and narrow or close this PR rather than changing the default.

options.title: Add an explicit mode
options.body: Preserve the current default and add a separate setting for binding-quota prioritization, accepting additional configuration and test surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt one binding lane
recommendation.body: Use the shared maximum-usage supported quota lane for both consumers so the displayed value matches the lane that caused Antigravity to rank highest.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner was directly asked to settle this provider-wide automatic-selection policy and can coordinate the Antigravity and Overview owners.
